title: rosa canina var. subcristata
intro: Rosa canina var. subcristata, commonly known as the dwarf dog rose, is a variety of the Rosa canina species, known for its smaller size and unique subcristate seed pods. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to promote health and well-being, with documented health benefits including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and combat infections. The therapeutic actions of Rosa canina var. subcristata include astringent, diuretic, and expectorant properties, which may aid in treating diarrhea, urinary issues, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents responsible for its health benefits include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, such as vitamin C, flavonols, and carotenoids, which contribute to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
